judgement.reason: Kiwi TCMS is a Django web app using MySQL/PostgreSQL with uploads movable to S3, so a contained change makes it deployable.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares db (mariadb:latest) in docker-compose.yml; mariadb (a Helm dependency) in helm/Chart.yaml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared db service is MariaDB, a MySQL-compatible database that the app reaches through KIWI_DB_* settings, so Deployz's managed MySQL 8 can replace it.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: volume uploads:/Kiwi/uploads:Z (docker-compose.yml web)
reviews.reason: The uploads volume holds user file attachments, and no shown line sends them to S3, so they would be lost on every restart.
